vocab_words.example: The company went from near bankruptcy to a high level of profitability
Please review the agenda before tomorrow's meeting.
All correspondence with clients must be archived.
The manager sent a memorandum about the new dress code.
We need to order more stationery for the office.
The filing system was reorganized last month.
Her itinerary includes three cities in five days.
The board decided to postpone the annual meeting.
Each attendee received a printed handout.

items.question: This is one of the ___ effective marketing strategies we have used.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc so sánh nhất "one of the most + adj".

items.question: Ms. Tran has worked at this company ___ 2019.
items.explanation: "Since + mốc thời gian" (2019) diễn tả hành động bắt đầu từ thời điểm đó tới nay.

items.question: The staff were given clear instructions ___ how to use the new system.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "instructions on how to...".

items.question: The document must be reviewed carefully ___ submitting it.
items.explanation: Ngữ cảnh cần trước khi nộp thì phải xem lại tài liệu, dùng "before".

items.question: The company's revenue ___ substantially since the merger.
items.explanation: "Since + mốc thời gian" đi cùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành.

items.question: The technician repaired the machine ___ than expected.
items.explanation: So sánh hơn của tính từ ngắn "fast" là "faster".

items.question: Customers can track their orders ___ our new mobile application.
items.explanation: "Through" nghĩa là thông qua, bằng phương tiện gì.

items.question: The company's profits have grown steadily ___ the past five years.
items.explanation: "Over the past + khoảng thời gian" diễn tả một quá trình kéo dài.

items.question: Employees who arrive late ___ notify their supervisor immediately.
items.explanation: Động từ khiếm khuyết "should" đi với động từ nguyên mẫu không "to".

items.question: Please make sure the report is ___ accurate before submission.
items.explanation: Cần trạng từ để bổ nghĩa cho tính từ "accurate".
